info.title: SmartCampus AI — Backend API
info.description: Backend API for IIT/ISB university orientation. Public catalogue exposes only published programmes and independently verified details. Staff and candidate identities use separate bearer sessions and role permissions. Anonymous visitor chat remains available without an account. Full RAG, voice and official admission decisions are not yet implemented.

token.title: Token
token.description: One-time secret; send via X-Visitor-Token for later requests

StaffBearer.description: Opaque token obtained from POST /api/v1/auth/login. Not the visitor token.

VisitorSessionToken.description: Session token returned by POST /visitor/sessions. Never share or log this token.
VisitorSessionToken.name: X-Visitor-Token

BootstrapKey.description: ONE-TIME bootstrap only. This is not a staff login token.
BootstrapKey.name: X-Admin-Key

CandidateBearer.description: Candidate token from POST /api/v1/candidates/login; NOT a staff token
